notes.title: Groovity Demo: Speedrun Update Out Now!
notes.content: [h1][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/138188cedfd4f90a0f0c5ec13c3590078e0a31c5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Dear speedrunners, Groovity Demo just received an important update![/b][/h2][p]We've listened to your feedback and bring a new feature that will unleash your speedy side. At Beyond Toppings' office we've worked on a Victory Screen![/p][p]After finishing a level, you can now check the time it took, as well as the deaths and Miuris you collected. We all have speedrunner friends, so don't be shy to share the demo with them to bring out your best skills. We want to see your most stunning videos, but more importantly we want to see how much fun you have trying to finish the Demo in the fastest time possible.[/p][p]Challenge yourself to get the best times and share them with others![/p][p]In the future we will announce more details about new updates, so keep an eye on us! Many thanks for your continued support through your downloads and comments, they give us the strength to keep expanding Groovity.[/p][p][b]Beyond Toppings Team[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/b2c9d82b2f1e0cc3eaf0379d379fbfbc67f74e37.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: A week of Groovity on Steam! Statistics and Fun Facts
notes.content: [h3][b]A week of Groovity on Steam! Don't miss out on your gameplay statistics[/b][/h3][p]The [b]Groovity[/b] demo has been available for a week now, and hundreds of you have already played it, with over [b]300 wishlists[/b]! Thank you very much to everyone, and to celebrate the occasion, we've prepared some [b]statistics and fun facts[/b] that we hope you'll love.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/738ce2d9b984f6e2482e8d1d5f29e093a146e89f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Where have most players died?[/b][/h3][p]Without a doubt, [b]Level 4, Jackpontrol[/b], has been the point where most people have had the hardest battle so far. That level is the final challenge of the demo, so we were already expecting this result a little bit. [b]Mr. Puginson[/b] wasn't going to make it easy for you![/p][p][/p][p]If you also fell there... you're not alone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/d8eccb1c3ca5c3254e46142d5aeeb905b7b89758.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]How long did it take to defeat the final boss?[/b][/h3][p]If you manage to time your dodges and attacks right the first time, you can beat the fight in about [b]2 minutes[/b]. But as we mentioned before, [b]Mr. Puginson[/b] is a tough nut to crack, and most players defeated him in about [b]6 minutes[/b]. What a fight![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/4a9a8a5fb14fe85be8a17ef48cceff2030652030.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]How many deaths did we have in the demo?[/b][/h3][p]Each player died about [b]35-40 times[/b], but on average, you played the demo for [b]25 minutes[/b]. We love this because we know that despite the difficulty, you found Groovity to be a challenge that kept you hooked for quite some time![/p][p][/p][p]As a fun fact, the development team has not yet achieved a no-hit run, but we do have a record time of [b]12 minutes[/b] to complete the [b]4 levels[/b]. Do you think you can beat this time?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/4f854aedded5c18533ce77f36c9656dd7e5c9695.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What are our players' first impressions?[/b][/h3][p]Who better than you to talk about this? Here are some accolades from the [b]reviews[/b] we've had on the demo![/p][p][/p][p]“Good game, excellent level design, very good use of gravity mechanics” - [b]Goater The Goat of Goats[/b][/p][p][/p][p]“It's like playing a 2D level of Mario Galaxy where gravity changes” - [b]BestBoy01[/b][/p][p][/p][p]“Very good graphics, catchy music, and excellent design, especially the infinite gravity sections that bring very imaginative variations to the game.” - [b]caye.val[/b][/p][p][/p][p]“Visually it's incredible, you can see the professionalism of the team and the atmosphere is very immersive.” - [b]chisi[/b][/p][p][/p][p]“A game with a lot of untapped potential, one of those titles you remember above all for its difficulty.” - [b]yixtel[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/d0d35a17d015f306941c1a952c7126d3797f5957.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Haven't tried it yet?[/b][/h3][p]The [b]Groovity[/b] demo is available for [b]FREE[/b] on Steam![/p][p][b]Download[/b] it now and join the most challenging experience in space.[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] to support us.[/p]

notes.title: Developers talk about Groovity
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]What has been your experience working on Groovity?[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Design Department[/b][/h3][p]Our experience designing Groovity has been rewarding because it has been full of complex challenges that we have overcome as a team, and slightly bittersweet because of all the ideas that were discarded and several elements that remain unpolished.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Art Department[/b][/h3][p]Our experience on the project has been challenging. Week after week, we faced new challenges, often without knowing how to solve them, but with boundless motivation and determination. It is undoubtedly an experience that we will remember fondly.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Programming Department[/b][/h3][p]Challenging and a lot of fun. We've had to learn how to use different tools and solve many challenges in a very short time, so we're also grateful that we've had a great, passionate, and talented team with us every step of the way.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Production Department[/b][/h3][p]A rewarding challenge and something we'll remember forever. Helping the team make their vision for the game a reality, seeing how it took shape and how, over these months, we all worked together to create a demo we are proud of.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Marketing Department[/b][/h3][p]Working at Groovity has been a creative roller coaster. From day one, we knew we weren't just making another game; we were creating something with soul, rhythm, and personality. The best part has been seeing the game evolve little by little: the first GIFs, the prototypes with rhythm, the real reactions of the testers with each substantial advance. It has been a constant source of pride and excitement to be part of the project.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/f5cbc02a2b19290fe8c2dd8e40d31a2be3217a97.png"][/img][/p][h2][b][u]What do you expect from Groovity in terms of audience response?[/u][/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Design Department[/b][/h3][p]From Design, we hope that the public will find it a fun and exciting game, where the time spent by the player is worthwhile.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Art Department[/b][/h3][p]Without a doubt, the best feeling we can get is seeing people having fun. Hopefully, it will be so much fun that it's addictive, creating a unique experience where, as you play, you can feel all the effort and love we've put into it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Programming Department[/b][/h3][p]We hope they have fun, are motivated to play the whole game, and recommend it to others (and that they don't break the game).[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Production Department[/b][/h3][p]We hope they have a good time and enjoy themselves. We believe we have made a game that is worth playing and that, throughout the levels, it richly explores the possibilities offered by playing with gravity.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Marketing Department[/b][/h3][p]We hope that people feel that Groovity is something special and that they enjoy it as much as we enjoyed creating it. We want it to hook them from the first jump and make them feel something different[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/b2af82f559725f3b9c14492d9471c3faadf231cb.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Groovity Launch: July 11
notes.content: [h1][b]The wait is almost over![/b]   [/h1][p]We are thrilled to finally share that the Groovity demo will be released on July 11, and we can't wait for you to dive into the adventure and start manipulating gravity at will.  [/p][p]But... why should you play Groovity? [/p][p][/p][p]Let us give you some good reasons! [/p][p]   [/p][h2][b]Why you should play Groovity[/b]  [/h2][p][/p][h3][b]A gravitational twist at your command[/b]  [/h3][p]Groovity lets you change gravity in four directions: up, down, left, and right, transforming any surface into a possible path. It's a unique twist that challenges how you move, how you plan, and how you think.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/98d96562d3212b30a38171f5118f808125ce5df4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A cool groove style[/b]  [/h3][p]Explore a spaceship filled with neon lights, vibrant colors, and challenges that will test your platforming skills. Move to the beat of a dynamic soundtrack that evolves as you dodge lasers, face enemies, and escape the traps that NeoCosmos Corp has set in your path.      [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/7d9a4afe1995403a0fe713f7be4b8ce20847ee09.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Challenging levels with creative solutions[/b]  [/h3][p]In each level, you'll face a challenge that rewards speed and ingenious movement in order to progress. The key will be how you combine gravity changes, timing, and your own style to keep moving forward!      [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/f5cbc02a2b19290fe8c2dd8e40d31a2be3217a97.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Agile, intuitive, but demanding[/b]  [/h3][p]Groovity is one of those games that is easy to learn but difficult to master. Whether you're a casual platformer fan or a true speedrunner, you'll find fresh challenges and space to test your skills in moving quickly and stylishly through the ship.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/1cbb3a3fc4542453f49e6e73953f82966d2d8872.png"][/img] [/p][h2][u][b]Save the date: July 11[/b][/u]  [/h2][p]Mark your calendars!   [/p][p]The Groovity demo will be available for free on Steam starting July 11.  Don't forget to add Groovity to your wish list to support the project and follow all the latest news.[/p]

notes.title: HOW ARE OUR LEVELS CREATED?
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]How do we plan the level before creating it?[/b][/u][/h3][p]Before we start, the first thing we do is ask ourselves a series of questions such as:[/p][list][*][p]What happens during the level?[/p][/*][*][p]At what point in the game will it appear?[/p][/*][*][p]What set of elements appear during the level?[/p][/*][*][p]When the player reaches this level, what should they know and what should we teach them?[/p][/*][*][p]Do we have any limits or restrictions?[/p][/*][/list][p]By answering these questions, we have the information we need to start planning the level.[/p][p]The next step is to decide on the layout of the screens, indicating what happens on each screen, taking into account the limitations and consistency of the level. For example, we have to ensure that we do not show the player elements they are unfamiliar with in dangerous situations on any screen, to avoid moments of frustration and to accommodate the difficulty curve of the level.[/p][p]With all these questions answered and our screen layout complete, we move on to the next step.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/eb092872a463a0cbcf37fd417a8fa8c3a96233e9.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]How do we create the level?[/b][/u][/h3][p]To create each level, we have to create all its screens. The process we follow is as follows:[/p][list][*][p]First, we make a sketch, on paper or in a tool where we can quickly and easily make changes to the screen we want to create. We make all the changes we want and test it as much as we want until we say, “This is the screen!”[/p][/*][*][p]Second, we transfer that sketch to the game, either manually or with a tool that automates the process, so that we can now play the sketch we had made.[/p][/*][*][p]Third, we play the screen we have created. If at this point we don't feel any rough edges, anything to complain about, or anything that makes us think, “Maybe this wasn't the screen,” we're done. Otherwise, we correct it and test it again until we think, “Now this is the screen!”[/p][/*][*][p]Fourth, we have someone other than ourselves, probably a team member, play the screen. If there are any rough edges, we analyze them, correct them, go back to step 3, and repeat the loop until we think, “That's it, now it's right!”[/p][/*][*][p]Finally, we take these levels to different playtesting sessions, approximately once a month, where we test the levels we have refined internally with players outside the project. This is when we put all the iterations and refinements to the test, gathering lots of feedback to improve the Groovity levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/22f39c45e98ce04642b6445dbbda6d900b67d943.png"][/img][/p][h3][u][b]How do we adjust based on feedback?[/b][/u][/h3][p]The first thing we do with feedback is write everything down, both what we see and what we are told, regardless of what it is. [/p][p]Then, we compile all this feedback, analyze it, and determine what works and what doesn't. With this information, we propose possible actions for each relevant aspect we have identified and test these changes. [/p][p]If we are convinced by the result, we apply it to the game, and if not, we continue iterating alternatives until we find one that works.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/2dd97d95a1576f982e1567d520e8f28cb9423a02.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: MEET GROOVY
notes.content: [h2][u]Questions about the art:[/u][/h2][h2] [/h2][h3][b]How did the design of Groovy come about? What references or inspirations were key in shaping it?[/b] [/h3][p]His design is the result of an extensive search for references, followed by a creative process. We were mainly inspired by the retro-futuristic groovy style shown in the Space Groove series of League of Legends, cat figures, and many other cartoon characters with exaggerated proportions and carefree features.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What did we want to convey with his silhouette and facial expression? What does his appearance say about his personality?[/b] [/h3][p]His silhouette is based on rounded, soft shapes that reflect his carefree, friendly, and somewhat mischievous personality. The same is true of his facial expression, which is simple but representative of a playful and determined attitude.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]How did his design evolve from the first sketches to the final look we see in the game?[/b] [/h3][p]Groovy's design went through several stages. Initially, various silhouettes were proposed for her figure: some tall and slender, others stocky and burly, etc. We ended up opting for the current one, which is flat with gentle, exaggerated curves. Then we moved on to choosing his clothes, at which point we came up with his special boots and gloves, as well as his jacket and belt.      [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/a9126afc18d075afe96cb870be9d19fb669f6335.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/1ee37ff2bce547672f713a73261a4f34ffe594c7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Were there any discarded ideas or alternative versions of Groovy during the design process?[/b] [/h3][p]Of course, in addition to other versions with different colors, different clothes and accessories were also proposed for him. Did you know that there were versions of Groovy that wore a backpack, hat, or fanny pack?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/174537d80dde779cb3e5975ebf5246506be00c52.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/b7a49553df9f9ae6bfc6e805735d1f3a720bfae2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/cbb9718f740c537e277b4e33c1df2f9366233ecc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]How important is the “groovy” aesthetic in his design? How does it integrate with the world and levels of the game?[/b] [/h3][p]Thanks to the groovy aesthetic, our cartoonish hero is born, with a retro-space style full of color, rhythm, and humor. That's why he has a relaxed, confident, and somewhat mischievous attitude. This aesthetic is also reflected in the settings, which are full of vibrant, contrasting colors and sharp contours, as well as various posters and graffiti with a fun vibe. [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Questions about the narrative:[/u] [/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Who is Groovy in the Groovity universe? What is his background or story prior to the events of the game?[/b][/h3][p] Groovy's race is commonly known for excelling at anything related to numbers, and they are very adept at solving any type of equation presented to them. Our protagonist aspired to work as a great inventor to make life easier and solve problems for everyone, which is why entering NeoCosmos was his main goal.  [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]What motivates Groovy to rebel against NeoCosmos Corp? Is he an accidental hero, or did he have a plan from the start?[/b] [/h3][p]Groovy feels compelled to rebel against NeoCosmos when he finds himself trapped in a monotonous routine of creating useless gadgets, artifacts of little use, and bland trinkets that bring him no satisfaction. Added to this is the frustration of seeing how neither he nor his fellow Miuri assistants received due recognition for the countless hours they dedicated to the company's projects. So the best way to get revenge was to use his own project against them.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What sets him apart from other platform protagonists? Why connect with him as a player?[/b] [/h3][p]Groovy is not a hero. Groovy seeks to rebel with mischief and in the most daring way just for the pleasure of causing trouble and creating chaos in the most diligent and meticulous company in the galaxy. You don't have to be a hero to rebel, sometimes you just have to be a little mischievous.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]How is his personality reflected in the gameplay? Is the gravity system related to how he sees the world?[/b][/h3][p]His roguish expression and the confidence with which he is able to overcome all the obstacles that come his way make him a well-rounded design. His ability to change his axis of gravity is thanks to the theft of NeoCosmos' most “innovative” project, a pair of zero-gravity boots exclusively for use at the opening of the coolest nightclub in the galaxy.   [/p][p][/p][h3][b]What is the relationship between Groovy and his companions? What drives him to rescue them?[/b]   [/h3][p]The Miuris are Groovy's lab assistants, and they are excellent at supporting and assisting in any project. However, they do not stand out for being the most skilled or strongest, so they are commonly overlooked in the company's dynamics. For this reason, Groovy feels the need to get them out of there so that the rest of the world can appreciate their true potential.[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Groovity has landed: Discover the new gravity-defying platformer!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome![/b][/h1][p]We are pleased to present [b]Groovity[/b], a vibrant 2.5D platformer set in deep space, where gravity becomes both your greatest ally and your toughest challenge. Developed by [b]Beyond Toppings[/b], the game is officially [b][u]coming for free on Steam July 11[/u][/b].

In Groovity, you’ll explore a spaceship controlled by the evil [b]NeoCosmos Corp.[/b], as you guide [b]Groovy[/b], a charismatic engineer, on a mission to free his friends and escape the company’s twisted experiments.

🎥 Watch the teaser trailer here: 
[/p][previewyoutube="WlNrvX_vk-s;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
🕹️ Core Gameplay
You can [b]manipulate gravity in four directions[/b]: up, down, left, and right, to overcome mind-bending puzzles and traverse intricately designed levels. Jump and launch yourself through dynamic 2.5D environments built for players who think fast and move faster.

🌌 Story & Setting
Groovy thought he was joining the galaxy’s most innovative company. Instead, he became a pawn in their unethical project: [b]gravity-altering boots[/b] to control laborers. With the final prototype in his hands, he decides to steal it and escape from the evil intentions of [b]NeoCosmos[/b], turning the very invention he helped create against his captors.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/9ba99502a8839870a8c5192b9cb4ea19fb75a13b.png"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]🎨 Key Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p] [b]Explore [/b]a spaceship filled with diverse environments, from high-tech laboratories with industrial vibes to neon-lit disco chambers bursting with groove.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Embark [/b]on a rhythm-fueled escape full of challenging puzzles, timing-based movement and precision.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Master [/b]a unique way to flip, fall, and fly your way through danger by altering your personal gravity at will.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Conquer [/b]fast-paced, creative challenges that demand quick thinking and gravity-defying strategies.
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Feel [/b]the groove as your gravity-defying moves sync with a dynamic soundtrack that amplifies every jump, twist, and fall.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638908/2dd97d95a1576f982e1567d520e8f28cb9423a02.png"][/img]
[/p][h2][b]💾 Platforms & Availability[/b][/h2][p]Groovity launches [b]July 11th[/b], [b]2025[/b] on [b]Steam[/b], completely [b]free to play[/b].
